name: 肿瘤免疫与微环境预设
description: 专注于免疫细胞亚群、肿瘤免疫微环境(TME)、免疫检查点受体配体与细胞因子通信网络的分类体系。

Immune_Cell_Subset.label: 免疫细胞亚群
Immune_Cell_Subset.description: CD8+ T细胞、Treg调节性T细胞、NK细胞、巨噬细胞(M1/M2)、树突细胞(DC)等
Immune_Cell_Subset.en_description: CD8+ T cells, regulatory T cells (Tregs), NK cells, M1/M2 macrophages, dendritic cells (DCs).

Tumor_Stroma_Cell.label: 肿瘤细胞 / 基质细胞
Tumor_Stroma_Cell.description: 恶性肿瘤克隆细胞、癌症相关成纤维细胞(CAF)、内皮细胞
Tumor_Stroma_Cell.en_description: Malignant tumor clones, cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), or endothelial cells.

Immune_Checkpoint.label: 免疫检查点受体 / 配体
Immune_Checkpoint.description: PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, TIGIT, CD47等
Immune_Checkpoint.en_description: Coinhibitory or costimulatory receptors/ligands (PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIGIT, CD47).

Cytokine_Chemokine.label: 细胞因子 / 趋化因子
Cytokine_Chemokine.description: IFN-γ, TNF-α, TGF-β, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, CXCL9/10等游离分子
Cytokine_Chemokine.en_description: Soluble signaling molecules (IFN-γ, TNF-α, TGF-β, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, CXCL9/10).

Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.label: 微环境代谢物 / 胞外成分
Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.description: 乳酸、腺苷、色氨酸代谢产物(Kynurenine)、胶原蛋白、胞外基质
Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.en_description: Microenvironmental metabolites (lactate, adenosine, kynurenine) and extracellular matrix (ECM).

Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.label: 免疫表型 / 效应反应
Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.description: T细胞耗竭(Exhaustion)、免疫抑制、抗原呈递、穿孔素杀伤、炎症浸润
Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.en_description: T cell exhaustion, immunosuppression, antigen presentation, cytotoxic killing, or infiltration.

Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.description: 文献证据不足或上下文含糊、无法明确归类的免疫分子或概念
Uncertain.en_description: Immunological molecules or concepts lacking sufficient evidence in literature.

Immune_Suppression.label: 免疫抑制 / 耗竭诱导
Immune_Suppression.en_description: Induction of T cell exhaustion, checkpoint signaling, or immunosuppressive barrier formation.

Immune_Activation_Cytotoxicity.label: 免疫激活 / 细胞毒杀伤
Immune_Activation_Cytotoxicity.en_description: Activation of effector immune cells and perforin/granzyme-mediated cytotoxic tumor killing.

Ligand_Receptor_Binding.label: 受体-配体特异性结合
Ligand_Receptor_Binding.en_description: Specific immune checkpoint ligand-receptor engagement or cytokine-receptor binding.

Recruitment_Chemotaxis.label: 细胞招募 / 趋化迁移
Recruitment_Chemotaxis.en_description: Chemokine-directed immune cell trafficking, homing, or stromal infiltration.

Cytokine_Secretory_Induction.label: 诱导分泌 / 细胞因子释放
Cytokine_Secretory_Induction.en_description: Triggering transcriptional upregulation and secretion of cytokines or chemokines.

Phenotype_Polarization.label: 表型转化 / 极化分化
Phenotype_Polarization.en_description: Phenotypic polarization or differentiation (e.g. M1 to M2 macrophage transition).

en_description: Classification framework focused on immune cell subsets, tumor microenvironment (TME), checkpoint molecules, and cytokine signaling.

patterns: .*(?:淋巴细胞|单核细胞|巨噬细胞|中性粒细胞|树突状细胞|t细胞|b细胞)$
rules.reason_zh: 匹配肿瘤浸润免疫细胞亚群或造血淋巴细胞命名
rules.reason_en: Matches immune cell subpopulation or tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte nomenclature

rules.sub_type_zh: 肿瘤细胞 / 基质细胞
patterns: .*(?:肿瘤细胞|癌细胞|基质细胞|内皮细胞|成纤维细胞)$
rules.reason_zh: 匹配恶性肿瘤细胞系或微环境基质细胞类型
rules.reason_en: Matches malignant tumor cell line or stromal cell component

rules.sub_type_zh: 免疫检查点受体 / 配体
rules.reason_zh: 匹配经典免疫检查点共刺激/共抑制分子受体或配体
rules.reason_en: Matches canonical immune checkpoint receptor or ligand

rules.sub_type_zh: 细胞因子 / 趋化因子
patterns: .*(?:细胞因子|趋化因子|白介素|干扰素)$
rules.reason_zh: 匹配细胞间通信白介素、干扰素或趋化因子命名
rules.reason_en: Matches intercellular communication cytokine, interleukin, or chemokine

rules.sub_type_zh: 微环境代谢物 / 胞外成分
patterns: .*(?:代谢物|微环境因子|基质胶原)$
rules.reason_zh: 匹配肿瘤微环境特征可溶性因子、免疫代谢物或胞外基质
rules.reason_en: Matches tumor microenvironment soluble factor, immunometabolite, or ECM component

rules.sub_type_zh: 免疫表型 / 效应反应
rules.reason_zh: 匹配肿瘤免疫微环境效应表型或免疫反应过程
rules.reason_en: Matches tumor microenvironment immune response or phenotype process
